premise: Every time Dog runs into the waves he comes back and shakes all over Lola, so she turns the umbrella into a shield, and Dog thanks her with a big wet lick anyway.
inspiration: The three-tries comic pattern (the fool who repeats the trick), ending with the trick outfoxed and forgiven.
lesson: You can't stay cross with a happy dog.

en-US.title: Dog Shakes
en-US.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} Lola was sitting under the umbrella, {girl:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} nice and dry. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Dog was not dry. {dog:go to shore} He ran down to the water, {sfx:splash} {dog:go to girl} splash! And back he came, {dog:live shake} and SHOOK. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] "Dog! I'm all wet!" [playfully] Off he went again. {dog:go to shore} Splash… {dog:go to girl} and back, {dog:live shake} SHAKE! {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] "Not AGAIN!" [short pause] So Lola had a plan. When Dog came back the third time, {umbrella:live spin} she spun the umbrella round to face him, like a big red-and-white shield. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} Shake, shake, shake! Every drop landed on the umbrella. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [proudly] "Ha! Dry!" {dog:face happy} Dog wagged his tail, {dog:go to girl} trotted round the umbrella… and gave her a big, wet lick on the nose. {girl:says} [giggles] "Oh, DOG!" {dog:hearts}

Y volvió, {dog:live shake} y se SACUDIÓ. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Perro! ¡Me has mojado!» [playfully] Allá fue otra vez. {dog:go to shore} Chof… {dog:go to girl} y de vuelta, {dog:live shake} ¡SACUDIDA! {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡OTRA vez no!» [short pause] Así que Lola tuvo una idea. Cuando Perro volvió por tercera vez, {umbrella:live spin} giró la sombrilla hacia él, como un gran escudo rojo y blanco. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} ¡Sacude, sacude, sacude! ja-JP.title: イヌくんの ぶるぶるっ
ja-JP.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}ローラは、ビーチパラソルの下で、{girl:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}からっと、いいきもち。{girl:face happy}{dog:enter}イヌくんは、びしょびしょ。{dog:go to shore}水へかけていって、{sfx:splash}{dog:go to girl}ざぶん！もどってくると、{dog:live shake}ぶるぶるぶるっ！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[laughs]「イヌくん！ぬれちゃったー！」 [playfully]イヌくんは、また、いっちゃった。{dog:go to shore}ざぶん…{dog:go to girl}もどってきて、{dog:live shake}ぶるぶるっ！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「もう、またなのー！」 [short pause]そこでローラは、ひらめきました。三どめにイヌくんがもどってきたとき、{umbrella:live spin}パラソルをくるっとまわして、イヌくんにむけたのです。赤と白の、大きなたてみたいに。{dog:shake}{umbrella:spray}ぶるぶる、ぶるぶる、ぶるぶるっ！しずくは、ぜんぶパラソルに。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[proudly]「へへん！ぬれてないもん！」 {dog:face happy}イヌくんは、しっぽをふりふり、{dog:go to girl}パラソルのむこうへ、とことこまわって…ローラのはなを、ぺろーん！{girl:says}[giggles]「もう、イヌくんったら！」 {dog:hearts}

de-DE.title: Der Hund schüttelt sich
de-DE.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} Lola saß unter dem Sonnenschirm, {girl:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} schön im Trockenen. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Der Hund war gar nicht trocken. {dog:go to shore} Er rannte hinunter zum Wasser, {sfx:splash} {dog:go to girl} platsch! Und schon kam er zurück {dog:live shake} und SCHÜTTELTE sich. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] „Hund! Jetzt bin ich ganz nass!“ [playfully] Und wieder ging es los. {dog:go to shore} Platsch… {dog:go to girl} und zurück, {dog:live shake} SCHÜTTEL! {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] „Nicht SCHON wieder!“ [short pause] Da hatte Lola einen Plan. Als der Hund zum dritten Mal angerannt kam, {umbrella:live spin} drehte sie den Sonnenschirm zu ihm hin, wie einen großen rot-weißen Schild. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} Schüttel, schüttel, schüttel! Jeder Tropfen landete auf dem Schirm. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [proudly] „Ha! Trocken!“ {dog:face happy} Der Hund wedelte mit dem Schwanz, {dog:go to girl} tapste um den Schirm herum… und schlabberte ihr einmal dick und nass über die Nase. {girl:says} [giggles] „Ach, DU!“ {dog:hearts}

fr-FR.title: Chien s’ébroue
fr-FR.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} Lola était assise sous le parasol, {girl:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} bien au sec. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Chien, lui, n’était pas au sec du tout. {dog:go to shore} Il a couru jusqu’à l’eau, {sfx:splash} {dog:go to girl} plouf ! Puis il est revenu, {dog:live shake} et il s’est SECOUÉ. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] « Chien ! Je suis toute mouillée ! » [playfully] Et le revoilà parti. {dog:go to shore} Plouf… {dog:go to girl} et retour… {dog:live shake} rebelote, il s’est SECOUÉ ! {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] « Oh non, ENCORE ! » [short pause] Alors Lola a eu une idée. Quand Chien est revenu pour la troisième fois, {umbrella:live spin} elle a tourné le parasol vers lui, comme un grand bouclier rouge et blanc. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} Brrr, brrr, brrr ! Toute sèche ! » {dog:face happy} Chien a remué la queue, {dog:go to girl} il a fait le tour du parasol… et il lui a donné un grand coup de langue tout mouillé sur le nez. {girl:says} [giggles] « Oh, CHIEN ! » {dog:hearts}

it-IT.title: Cane si scrolla
it-IT.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} Lola se ne stava seduta sotto l'ombrellone, {girl:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} bella asciutta. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Cane, invece, asciutto non era per niente. {dog:go to shore} È corso giù fino all'acqua, {sfx:splash} {dog:go to girl} splash! Ed eccolo di ritorno, {dog:live shake} che si SCROLLAVA tutto. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] «Cane! Tutte le gocce sono finite sull'ombrellone. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [proudly] «Ah-ah! zh-TW.title: 小狗甩甩甩
zh-TW.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}蘿拉坐在遮陽傘下，{girl:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}乾乾爽爽的。{girl:face happy}{dog:enter}小狗可一點也不乾。{dog:go to shore}牠衝到水邊，{sfx:splash}{dog:go to girl}嘩啦！又跑回來，{dog:live shake}用力一甩！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[laughs]「狗狗！我全身都濕了啦！」 [playfully]咻，牠又跑走了。{dog:go to shore}嘩啦……{dog:go to girl}跑回來，{dog:live shake}甩——甩——甩！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「怎麼又來了啦！」 [short pause]於是，蘿拉想到一個辦法。小狗第三次跑回來的時候，{umbrella:live spin}她把遮陽傘轉過去對著牠，像一面紅白條紋的大盾牌。{dog:shake}{umbrella:spray}甩、甩、甩！水珠全都落在傘上。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[proudly]「哈哈！我還是乾的！」 {dog:face happy}小狗搖搖尾巴，{dog:go to girl}繞過遮陽傘……伸出舌頭，在她鼻子上大大地舔了一下，濕答答的。{girl:says}[giggles]「哎喲，狗狗！」 {dog:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 小狗抖一抖
zh-HK.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}蘿拉坐在太陽傘下面，{girl:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}乾乾爽爽的。{girl:face happy}{dog:enter}小狗就不同了，牠一身都濕。{dog:go to shore}牠跑到水邊，{sfx:splash}{dog:go to girl}嘩啦！又跑回來，{dog:live shake}用力一抖！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[laughs]「小狗！我成身都濕晒喇！」 [playfully]牠又跑走了。{dog:go to shore}嘩啦……{dog:go to girl}又跑回來，{dog:live shake}抖！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「又嚟？！」 [short pause]於是，蘿拉想到一個辦法。小狗第三次跑回來的時候，{umbrella:live spin}她把太陽傘一轉，對着小狗，好像一面紅白色的大盾牌。{dog:shake}{umbrella:spray}抖、抖、抖！每一滴水都落在太陽傘上。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[proudly]「哈！今次冇濕！」 {dog:face happy}小狗搖搖尾巴，{dog:go to girl}繞過太陽傘……在她的鼻子上，濕濕地舔了一大口。{girl:says}[giggles]「哎呀，小狗！」 {dog:hearts}
